QuestInfo.name: Inventing Fun
QuestInfo.2: You brought the pile of stuff back to #p2040009# and he looked really excited.

0.0: Ah, #b#h0##k!\nThis perfect timing can't be a coincidence! Could you do me a favor?
0.1: I just love fixing and repairing things. That's why I'm doing this right now!\nBut there's one thing I like more than fixing... #bmaking something new#k!
0.2: It's the purest joy that anyone can have!
0.3: I've repairing things for AGES. My hands need to do something FUN. \nCould you #bget me some materials#k so I can get back to my crafting?
0.4: My little plan requires #b20#k #bPropellers, Motors, and Plane Controllers#k.

yes.0: You're going to flip when you see what I build!\r\nGet those items!

no.0: Oh, that's a bummer. I hope you have time to help me out at some point.

1.0: Ooooh this is the moment I've been waiting for!\nDid you get it all?
1.1: You just wait, this is going to be the best invention ever!

item.0: Are you confused about where to go? You can find #b#o3210206##k at #b#m221021500##k, right above us, and #b#o3230303##k at #b#m221021100##k, right below us. You can also find #b#o3230304##k at #b#m221020900##k.\r\nI need #b20 of each component#k... Please let me know when you acquire all the materials.
